facts.fact: 归途 Lucas 为蓝眼女神丢魂被 Andra 打趣；她想着兜帽猎人正要开口说"我也遇到一个人"
facts.anchor: “And you didn’t think to ask her name?” Andra laughed.

facts.fact: 尖叫撕裂夜空：Lucas 瞬间切换保护者模式让她回家锁门，她口头答应却循声而去
facts.anchor: Screams ripped through the night air.

facts.fact: Bernice 家门口出现半人半兽怪物：无唇利齿、纯黑双眼，书里才见过的形态
facts.anchor: Heavy footfalls trudged through the home a moment before a black, clawed hand clung to the doorframe.

facts.fact: 怪物把肩上的东西砸在地上——不是东西，是 Bernice
facts.anchor: The monster ripped something from over its shoulder and slammed it onto the ground between them with a sickening crunch.

facts.fact: 黑雾滑入 Bernice 喉中，死去的老人带着不属于她的黑眼重新站起
facts.anchor: The black vapor slid down Bernice’s throat.

facts.fact: 恶魔首次喊出母亲之名：光女巫 Cecilia 之女，要为母亲的罪付出代价
facts.anchor: “Daughter of Cecilia the Light Witch,” she began again, “it is time you pay for your mother’s sins.”

facts.fact: 恶魔通牒：冬至月升前到"一切开始与结束之地"受审，否则每天杀一村民；背叛王座上的 Vasara 在等她
facts.anchor: “You have until moonrise on winter solstice to appear for your judgement.”

facts.fact: Bernice 夺回身体最后一刻告白"爱你如己出"，自捅腹部驱魔；章末她在床上沉睡，伤重但活着
facts.anchor: With trembling hands, Bernice plunged the blade into her abdomen.

facts.fact: Fergal 揭底：母亲就是传说中对抗 Edgeron 的光女巫，死时百余岁；兄妹的年龄与力量常年保密
facts.anchor: Your mother was the light witch that stood against Edgeron in the final battle.

facts.fact: 目的地揭晓：东北海岸学院——母亲与 Edgeron 相遇之地；Andra 拍板独自赴约，与 Lucas 大吵摔门
facts.anchor: “Edgeron attended academy on the Northeastern Shores.”
